trello_card.description:
## The Raine Group / Raine Ventures - VC Outreach Packet

### Fund Overview
- **Fund Name:** The Raine Group (Raine Partners IV, Raine Venture Partners)
- **Location:** New York, NY (global presence)
- **AUM:** $3.1+ billion across strategies
- **Stage Focus:** Growth equity and venture capital (Series B through pre-IPO)
- **Check Size:** $10M - $100M+ for growth equity; $3M - $15M for venture

### Investment Thesis
Raine manages strategies across growth equity and venture capital, focusing on fast-growing TMT (Technology, Media, Telecom) enterprises. Key sectors:
- Interactive entertainment & gaming
- Sports technology & media
- Digital media platforms
- Real money gaming
- Streaming & content platforms

**AI/Gaming Infrastructure Alignment:** HIGH
- Led $760M Raine Partners IV focused on sports, media, entertainment & gaming
- First investment from Fund IV: Tripledot Studios (mobile gaming)
- Strong thesis on gaming infrastructure and platforms
- Deep M&A advisory expertise in gaming (unique value-add)

### Key Partner: John Salter
- **Title:** Co-Founder & Partner
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-salter-5b5621/
- **Email:** john.salter@raine.com
- **Focus:** Responsible for Raine's interactive entertainment, real money gaming and digital media practice
- **Background:** Former Global Head of Digital Media at UBS Investment Bank (8+ years)
- **Board Positions:** Huuuge Games, Games24x7 (real money gaming)

**Secondary Contact: Joe Ravitch**
- Co-Founder & Partner
- Active across all Raine businesses
- Deep relationships with global entertainment conglomerates

### Notable Portfolio Companies
- **Tripledot Studios** - Mobile games developer (first Fund IV investment)
- **Within** (formerly VR company, entertainment software)
- **Waggle** - Social/platform software
- **Mobcrush** - Mobile gaming/streaming
- **Scopely** - Mobile game publisher
- **Bet365** - Sports betting (advisory)

### Recent Activity
- July 2023: Closed $760M Raine Partners IV
- Active in gaming M&A advisory (knows buyers personally)
- Strong network in both East Coast and European gaming markets

### Outreach Angle
**Primary Hook:** Gaming infrastructure at scale - Raine does growth-stage deals and brings unparalleled M&A advisory capabilities. Position as the infrastructure layer that enables their portfolio studios to scale.

**Secondary Hooks:**
1. Reference Tripledot Studios investment - show understanding of their gaming focus
2. Emphasize enterprise/platform play (not content) - fits growth equity profile
3. M&A angle: Raine can help with strategic exits given advisory business
4. John Salter's gaming focus - perfect fit for infrastructure outreach

### Outreach Strategy
1. Lead with growth metrics and scalability (they do growth equity, not seed)
2. Reference recent Tripledot investment and gaming thesis alignment
3. Emphasize enterprise/platform nature (not consumer game content)
4. Position for strategic value beyond capital - M&A relationships

### Unique Value Proposition
Raine is unique among VCs because they combine investing with elite M&A advisory. They know all the strategic buyers personally. For gaming infrastructure plays, this is a massive advantage at exit time.

### Resources
- Website: https://raine.com
- Investment Portfolio: https://raine.com/investment/
- Team: https://raine.com/team/
